28.name: Nick Allegretti
28.comment: questionable

28.name: Jayden Daniels
28.comment: Commanders head coach Dan Quinn said that Daniels (elbow) will be a limited participant in Wednesday's practice, John Keim of ESPN.com reports.

28.name: Nick Cross
28.comment: Cross (illness) won't travel to London with the Commanders and has been ruled out for Sunday's matchup against the Colts.

28.name: Antonio Williams
28.comment: Williams caught two passes on four targets for 15 yards during the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seahawks on Sunday.

28.name: Sam Cosmi
28.comment: Cosmi (concussion) isn't traveling with the Commanders to London and won't play Sunday versus Indianapolis.

28.name: Kaytron Allen
28.comment: Allen played 15 snaps exclusively on special teams during the Commanders' 33-31 win over the Seahawks on Sunday.

28.name: Percy Butler
28.comment: Butler is recovering from a concussion ahead of the Commanders' matchup in London against the Colts in Week 4, Ben Standig of The Team 980 Washington D.C. reports.

28.name: Leo Chenal
28.comment: The Commanders placed Chenal (neck) on injured reserve Tuesday.

28.name: Austin Ekeler
28.comment: Ekeler signed a one-year contract with the Commanders on Tuesday, Zach Selby of the team's official site reports.

28.name: Stefon Diggs
28.comment: Diggs caught four of seven targets for 33 yards during Sunday's 33-31 win over the Seahawks.

28.name: Drew Stevens
28.comment: Stevens hit both field-goal attempts, including a 57-yarder, and went 3-for-4 on extra-point tries in Sunday's 33-31 win over the Seahawks.

28.name: Terry McLaurin
28.comment: McLaurin caught six of nine targets for 77 yards and a touchdown in Sunday's 33-31 win over the Seahawks.

28.name: Jacory Croskey-Merritt
28.comment: Croskey-Merritt carried the ball 19 times for 36 yards and caught his only target for seven yards in Sunday's 33-31 win over the Seahawks.

28.name: Marcus Mariota
28.comment: Mariota completed 19 of 31 passes for 183 yards and three touchdowns in Sunday's 33-31 win over the Seahawks. He added 11 rushing yards on five carries.
